name: pair-bridge
description: Consult and manage local models through PAIR, including concurrent jobs across configured PCs for compatible MCP clients.

interface.shortDescription: Run local model tasks concurrently across PCs.
interface.longDescription: Inspect devices, discover concurrency with pair_capabilities, start model jobs on different PCs before polling, and manage exact model instances.
defaultPrompt: Use pair_devices and pair_list to inspect installed local models.
Use pair_smart_ask for a bounded task with an installed model.
Use pair_capabilities, then start pair_job_start on different PCs before polling pair_job_status.
